title: Test: the key help desk gives a staff member a new key
story: An engine test, not an intruder: script:perfect removes Nico Vega's own key on his three hosts at +120 s, as a defender does for a copied staff key.
The key help desk must give Nico a new key after its wait, so his lock-out is about the wait and below the No harm limit.
notes: Test scenario for the engine only. The one step runs on the attacker role and contacts no company host.
